name: adas-trail-app
description: Native (Expo/React Native) App Store wrapper around the Ada's Trail PWA — bundles the game on-device and serves it locally, plus Taptic haptics and an audio session.

scripts.ios:device: npm run prebuild:ios && expo run:ios --device --configuration Release
scripts.ios:device:debug: npm run prebuild:ios && expo run:ios --device --configuration Debug
scripts.build:preview: npm run bundle -- --profile preview && eas build --profile preview
scripts.build:testflight: npm run bundle -- --profile testflight && eas build --profile testflight --platform all
scripts.build:production: npm run bundle -- --profile production && eas build --profile production --platform all
